answer: We establish a cryptoeconomic security primitive where validators must anchor their staking collateral on a digital ledge, securing the consensus against identity multiplication. Under our new lotus protocol, a subgame-perfect punishment matrix propagates a punitive ripple of automated slashing penalties that completely wipe out malicious deposits. Consequently, the expected utility of a Sybil attack remains strictly negative, proving that honest validation constitutes a unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
